title: Boundless Water Pipe Adapter for CF/CFX Vaporizers
description: The universal water pipe adapter for the CF and CFX has the ability to fit on most male and female stems(14mm and 18mm). This enables the user to filter the vaporized product through water leaving a tasteful experience like no other. By unscrewing the top section of the water pipe adapter the user can easily switch between tubes, beakers, and water tool rigs.
